::: {.callout-note}
## From baseline to target

1. Preserve the Current State exports in `output/`.
2. Load the `.drawio` source and latest metadata observations in the Future State workspace.
3. Remove avoidable waits and rework, add pull signals where appropriate, and mark experiments with Kaizen bursts.
4. Set targets with consistent units and confirm that each reduction is realistic.
:::

## Example improvement

Suppose a review step has a baseline cycle time of 40 minutes, a lead time of 3 days, and a 10% error rate. A future design that limits work in progress, clarifies acceptance criteria, and triggers review with a pull signal might target 30 minutes, 1.5 days, and 4%.

| Gap measure | Calculation | Result |
|---|---|---:|
| Cycle time reduction | $(40 - 30) / 40 \times 100$ | 25% |
| Lead time reduction | $(3 - 1.5) / 3 \times 100$ | 50% |
| Defect/error reduction | $(10 - 4) / 10 \times 100$ | 60% |

Treat targets as hypotheses. Assign an owner and test each change before considering it part of the standard process.
